method: Full-page view_image inspection of all eight repaired atlas page JPEGs. No renderer or lesson JSON edits.

resolved_findings.result: Elbow connectors avoid event labels in both upward and downward lane transitions.
The denied long route uses the inter-row gutter, avoids the approval node, and stops before the intended executor boundary.
All four route badges are visible; offset ports separate the opposing adjacent routes, and the denied path avoids node text.
Executor / verifier wraps between words with no isolated character.
Neutral Count: k / n wording no longer labels forbidden effects as generic successes. Method explicitly defines k; numeric intervals sit outside the plot.

additional_checks.result: Count and interval annotations are readable beside the plot; point and whisker values remain consistent with the lesson data.
Packet values fit their cells. Revision 41 remains attached to its rollback phrase; no clipping or overlap.
Titles, introductions, diagrams, reading cues, prediction prompts, takeaways, assumptions and links remain intact.

nonblocking_observations.note: The long exact tool identifier occupies two lines inside its narrow field; every character is visible, and the full identifier is repeated in the introduction. No corrective action required.

coverage_note: The earlier review covered all 26 production-range atlas pages and book contact sheets 15-22. This follow-up inspects all eight changed pages supplied by the lead; the lead reports that the other reviewed page image hashes are unchanged.
conclusion: All five initial findings are resolved. No remaining actionable visual defects found in the repaired pages.
